next.reason: 1985: 'If the argument-1 series are not all integers, a numeric value is returned.' 2023 gives the same type in the uncatalogued type table of §2023:15.88.1: 'Numeric (some arguments may be integer) | Numeric'. §2023:15.2 GR4 defines a numeric function ('of the class and category numeric ... has an operational sign'). §2023:15.88.4 RV1 states only the value (the sum), not the type, so it is not named. No difference for a 1985 program.
